source_summary: Vertical Chinese garden landscape with scholar figures among dramatic ink rocks, bamboo, banana plants, grasses, and a tea setting. Motifs exclude calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture.

motifs.name: upper_left_bamboo_canopy
motifs.description: Dense arching bamboo canopy entering from the upper left, with overlapping leafy sprays and slender segmented stems extending toward the center.
must_preserve: dark-to-pale ink layering of clustered leaves
dry-brush accents on denser leaf masses

motifs.name: left_tall_garden_rock
motifs.description: Large vertical scholar rock rising along the left side, irregular and slab-like with a darker central face and pale washed planes; isolate the rock body and adjacent attached shadowed contours, excluding any inscription or seal on its surface.
must_preserve: dark recessed fissures near the lower center

motifs.name: central_jagged_peak
motifs.description: Tall narrow jagged rock peak in the upper center-right, with smaller adjoining spurs and dark interior clefts rising behind the foliage.

motifs.name: banana_grove
motifs.description: Cluster of broad banana leaves and pale trunks filling the middle of the painting, overlapping the central rocks; includes drooping, torn leaf edges and vertical stems but excludes scholar figures below.
must_preserve: slender pale trunks and leaf bases

motifs.name: middle_grasses_and_small_rocks
motifs.description: Low garden floor vegetation between the banana trunks: tufts of fine grasses, small rounded rocks, and light ground washes beneath the grove.

motifs.name: seated_musicians_scholars
motifs.description: Two seated scholar figures in robes at the lower middle: one playing a round-bodied pipa-like instrument, the other listening, with nearby small drum or basket and zither-like object.
must_preserve: folded robe contours with pale wash
round instrument body and long neck details

motifs.name: tea_attendant_stone_table
motifs.description: Right-side attendant beside a low stone platform or table with tea vessels, cups, and utensils; includes the crouched figure, table slab, supports, and objects on top.
must_preserve: attendant’s bent posture and robe folds
small facial features and hair knots
teapot, cups, stand, and vessel shapes
flat stone tabletop with rough ink edges

motifs.name: lower_foreground_rocks_bamboo
motifs.description: Bottom foreground rock formation with angular boulders and surrounding bamboo sprays, spanning the lower edge as a framing landscape base.
must_preserve: bamboo leaf clusters around the rocks
dry-brush texture on broken stone surfaces

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
